coordinate_system: local image pixel coordinates (NOT georeferenced, no CRS)
coordinate_note: Coordinates are IMAGE PIXEL coordinates, NOT geographic coordinates. Origin is the top-left corner of the image; one unit equals one image pixel; vertices lie on pixel corners (continuous coordinates). No CRS is assigned. Georeference these polygons before using them as map data.
origin: bottom-left (y axis flipped: y = image_height - y_pixel)
